title: P.6 Trigonometric Functions

icans: I can find exact values of the trigonometric functions in radians.
I can use the period and the even-odd properties to evaluate trigonometric functions.
I can find the amplitude and period of a sinusoidal function and write its equation.

vocab: a function f with a ___________ number p so that f(x + p) = f(x) for every x in its domain

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Sine from the unit circle
Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Domain and range: sine and cosine are defined for all real numbers and have range [−1, 1]; tan x is undefined at odd integer multiples of _______________.

blocks.stem:
Find the exact value.
a.  sin(5π/6)
b.  cos(7π/6)
c.  tan(3π/4)

notes: Periods: sine, cosine, secant, and cosecant have period 2π; tangent and cotangent have period _______________.

blocks.stem:
Find the exact value.
a.  tan(π/4 + 2π)
b.  sin(17π/6)

notes: Even-odd: cosine and secant are even; sine, tangent, cosecant, and cotangent are _______________.

blocks.stem:
Use the even-odd properties to find the exact value.
a.  tan(−π/4)
b.  sin(−3π/2)
c.  csc(−π/3)

notes: Sinusoids: y = A sin(ωx) and y = A cos(ωx), ω > 0, have amplitude |A| and period _______________.

blocks.stem:
Find the amplitude and period.
a.  g(x) = (1/2)cos(πx)
b.  f(x) = −2cos((3/2)x)

a.  Write a sine function with amplitude 2 and period π.
b.  Write a cosine function with amplitude 3 and period 4π.
Find the amplitude, period, and range of f(x) = 3cos(2x) − 4.
